_doc: The M5 lane's measure for the island-front fixes A (PLT-680) and B (PLT-681), 2026-10-26: the island and continental fronts from the dynamics record's boundary mix, their incipient and slow shares, the per-sample against per-pair convergence cross-tab, the front's turnover and the maturation events (PLT-683), and the plates' speeds by slab from plate.json. Measurement only. Pass it with --registry tools/review/islfront/measures_islab.json. Definitions in measure_islab.py.

islab.doc: island and continental fronts, the thermal floor's cross-tabs and the plate speeds by slab; definitions in tools/review/islfront/measure_islab.py
